description: This file defines the Vtiger_MailRecord class, which provides structured access to email details, including header parsing, body retrieval, and attachment handling within the vtiger CRM system.

classes.name: Vtiger_MailRecord
classes.description: Provides methods for parsing and accessing email header, body, and attachments.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns a string summarizing email sender, recipient, cc, bcc, date, and subject.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the object by parsing email header and optionally the body.

methods.name: getBodyText
methods.description: Returns the email body as plain text, optionally stripping HTML tags.

methods.name: getBodyHTML
methods.description: Returns the email body as HTML.

methods.name: fetchBody
methods.description: Fetches and parses the email body from the server if not already parsed.

methods.name: __getEmailIdList
methods.description: Converts email header info into a list of email addresses.

methods.name: __convert_encoding
methods.description: Converts string encoding to the target charset.

methods.name: __mime_decode
methods.description: Decodes MIME encoded strings, such as email subjects.

methods.name: __mime_encode
methods.description: Encodes strings into MIME format with specified encoding and charset.

methods.name: __parseHeader
methods.description: Parses email header info to extract sender, recipient, subject, date, and message ID.

methods.name: __parseBody
methods.description: Parses email body structure, handling multipart messages and attachments.

methods.name: __getpart
methods.description: Recursively processes email parts to extract content and attachments.
